children: iRhythm announced the planned acquisition of Vital Connect and that HSR clearance expired, with closing expected in early October 2026.
iRhythm entered a merger agreement to acquire Vital Connect, which will become an indirect wholly owned subsidiary.
Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period expired at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 18, 2026, clearing an antitrust milestone.
Acquisition is anticipated to close in early October 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and waivers.
Disclosure includes forward-looking statements about timing and completion and notes risks could delay or prevent closing.
